Identity and homelands

Ktunaxa homelands follow the Kootenay and Columbia rivers and adjoining areas across the Canada–U.S. border.

Read the sources [1] Ktunaxa Nation Council

02

Historical context

The Ktunaxa Nation Council explains its collective role while distinguishing four Canadian First Nations and related Kootenai communities in Montana and Idaho.

Read the sources [1] Ktunaxa Nation Council

03

Living communities and further study

A cross-border language initiative works with speakers from these communities. Ktunaxa identity is broader than one council or reservation.
